name: claude/resume
description: Loads the latest snapshot and current context, synthesizes a session briefing. Run this first thing in a new session — it tells you who you are, what you were doing, and what to do next.

params.name: verbose
params.description: Include full chat history and issue details (default: false — summary only)

results.name: snapshot
results.description: The latest saved snapshot (null if none exists)

results.name: gitSince
results.description: Git commits since the snapshot was taken

results.name: briefing
results.description: Human-readable session briefing — everything you need to resume

examples.notes: Returns briefing: last session summary + what changed since + next steps
Includes recent chat messages and full issue list
